verdict.rationale: Setting up a new machine by bringing a paired device near it is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents proximity-based or device-to-device setup. Online accounts sync (fedora-docs-9) is a related but different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can set up a new machine quickly by bringing a paired personal device near it
